aggregates.threshold_rationale: 0.05 chosen to match the V5b bias-bound 'strong' regime magnitude (β=0.0386) and exceed the bootstrap-noise scale (~0.02 on the PHASE10_SUBSET medians). Cells with |Δq*|_1 > 0.05 from λ=1.0 baseline are flagged as materially shifted; below this threshold the q* reading is stable across plausible λ values.

stability_verdict.verdict_meaning: lambda_stable: empirical readings stable across plausible λ ∈ {0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25}; full V5-integrated calibration named as §10.7 follow-up but does not materially affect findings. lambda_sensitive: empirical readings are λ-conditional; §10.7 moves up to primary limitation.

discrimination_verdict.meaning: If fleet-mean L1 differences across the three C constructions exceed bootstrap noise scale (~0.02) and at least some cells cross the 0.05 materially-shifted threshold, the apparatus discriminates among C channels in cell-specific ways -- supports §6 framing that C = a-b is one principled choice among three. If all three constructions produce q* values within bootstrap noise on every cell, the apparatus is not picking up channel-specific content the way the construction implies -- paper acknowledges this as a limitation.

aggregates.scope_limitations: Phase 7 kNN-MI anchor held fixed at canonical (a-b) construction across all three C variants. Re-firing Phase 7 per C variant would require the full kNN-MI pipeline (~5 min × 3 = 15 min additional wall time) and changes the anchor's input feature space. The current analysis isolates the apparatus's response to C feature variation while holding anchor fixed; reading shifts come from Phase 6 share recomputation and Phase 8 solver. Full anchor-and-classes re-fire across C variants is named as §10.4 follow-up if the current readings warrant it.
